inventory_metadata.classification_source: nvidia-a51 Slurm allocation and fabric metadata captured before any Phase60 transfer: `scontrol show topology` InfiniBand leaf/core tree plus per-node Slurm feature tags at 2026-08-24T05:50:18+00:00, and per-GPU HCA PCIe proximity from `nvidia-smi topo -m`. rack_id is the node's InfiniBand leaf switch, network_domain is the core switch above that leaf. No measured timing was consulted.
inventory_metadata.created_by: GPU environment agent (Claude Code) on the nvidia-a51 Slurm allocation
inventory_metadata.fabric_notes: nvidia-a51 B200 cluster, NDR InfiniBand three-level tree (root a51 -> ibccore* -> ibcleaf*). L1 replicas keep all four endpoint slots inside one host (prenyx0238 and prenyx0269) and still transfer over Mooncake RDMA. L2 replicas stay inside a single leaf switch (ibcleaf01-03: prenyx0238+prenyx0239; ibcleaf01-04: prenyx0269+prenyx0270). L3 replicas cross from ibcleaf01-03 to ibcleaf01-04 through core ibccore01. The two replicas of each level use disjoint hosts. Each host exposes 8x NVIDIA B200 and RDMA NICs ['mlx5_10', 'mlx5_13', 'mlx5_14', 'mlx5_15', 'mlx5_4', 'mlx5_7', 'mlx5_8', 'mlx5_9']; each endpoint uses the HCA with the closest PCIe proximity to its GPU.
